searchText: And on second read -- it appears this is now the actual spec. So I'm no longer asking for a Meta EIP, I'm asking for the actual Core EIP.. One thing I forgot about but was reminded of while de-spamming my discord: Do we want to formally add "prepare for address space expansion" to the list of opcode changes? It would be enumerating the opcodes that accept addresses beyond call, which I think is allready taken care of for the CALLS, just need to add BALANCE and one other I can't think of right now. Sorry been battling a fever for several days, will not be able to attend tomorrow (ergo can't present statistics on different swap instructions either, <@397452181827223554> might be able to attend for vyper tho)
